_about: Page addresses, their titles and descriptions (22 Oct 2026). Read by the site server (tools/localserver: the title and description in the first HTML of each address), by deeplinks.js (the title while browsing) and by tools/site-routes/build.mjs (sitemap.xml). Edit here, then run that build. No host is named here: each copy of the site uses its own address.

default.title: CrystalWorlds
default.description: A fan-built video and game preservation project. Every Nintendo Game & Watch, and Game Boy, NES, Super Nintendo, Nintendo 64, Pokémon mini, Atari and Sega games played in the browser from your own files, with photos, manuals and each system's hardware and emulation pages.

/home.title: CrystalWorlds
/home.description: What CrystalWorlds.Media is: a video and game preservation project with its own emulators for Game & Watch, Game Boy, NES, Super Nintendo, Nintendo 64, Pokémon mini, Atari and Sega, and how each one compares.

/features.title: CrystalWorlds
/features.description: Everything CrystalWorlds.Media does: the consoles and accessories we rebuilt, the play window, controls, the library, films and shows, game servers and vault codes, and every screen it runs on.
